    FIT VISION AI · SMART INDIA HACKATHON 2026

    AI-Driven Exercise Performance and Form Intelligence System

    Accessible exercise assistance using a laptop and webcam.

    PS 26196 · Fitness & Sports · Software

    From your presentation

    Webcam pose detection, exercise-specific rules, repetition counting, real-time visual and spoken feedback, Atlas coaching, and workout history.

    Working in this prototype

    MediaPipe pose landmarks run in the browser. Squats, bicep curls, and push-ups use joint-angle rules with visibility checks, stable movement states and full-cycle counting. Atlas delivers rule-based feedback with browser speech synthesis.

    Prototype implementation

    This demo uses JavaScript and browser-local history for a portable presentation. The PPT proposes Python, OpenCV, Streamlit + WebRTC and SQLite as the future application stack.

    Next development milestone

    Validated exercise thresholds across users, automatic exercise recognition, SQLite accounts and history, and LLM-powered Atlas conversations. No custom model training or clinical accuracy is claimed.

    Webcam→MediaPipe pose→Angles + rules→Atlas + metrics
    Concept reference: shradha-khapra / ai-gym-coach ↗. Original interface and exercise rule implementation for Fit Vision AI. Pose technology: Google MediaPipe.
